notes.title: Hellbound Ropes has released!!!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44615928/762741026329cdeb3ecb3b4ee76d65f776f8b87a.png[/img]
Hi, I'm HighCl from Blail Games, a solo developer.
I'm writing today to share some happy news.
My game has finally been released!!!!!

Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2591090/Hellbound_Ropes/

Stove: 
https://store.onstove.com/ko/games/2657


After an eventful start in January of this year.
Finally...!!!!!!! It's been a dream launch...!

As a solo developer, there are many regrets due to physical limitations,
There were so many things that happened during the launch.
Thanks to that, I think I can enjoy the joy of launching like this lol.
History summary: https://blog.naver.com/fdsa1469/223190450996

I'll be writing a blog post summarizing the events of the past.
We're also organizing an Instagram launch event soon, so I'll post more about that later!

The Instagram event will be hosted by the following accounts!
@hellbound_ropes
https://www.instagram.com/hellbound_ropes/

Thank you
